explanation: Band 3, +11.9% (17.7 -> 19.8 s), on the landing engine after the perf-audit's three corrections. (1) The seat region and the free-ground grid rasterized over a seating window, the grid exact past it (perf-318-control-windows); (2) the 40-household web growth the layout, not the web code (perf-318-control-web); (3) the cells past the window decided in one call (perf-318-control-cells: 7.56 -> 6.80 s over the four 15-household seatings). The pool hamlets are byte-identical through all three. What remains is plan D4, the GM's ruling - the open seat nearest the field first, every direction and ring offered at once: the control with D4 removed reads 18.9 s (0.9 s of the 2.1; the previous engine's pair 1.9 s; the audit's medians 2.06 s of homesteads CPU), and it buys a mean house-to-field distance of 355-394 ft against main's 416-443 (research.md R1). Seed 18 of the cohort, eleven margins thrown away on main, seats on its first in 2.4 s against 18.7 s.
